tei:div.tei:p: 85)༄༅/ sbyor sgrol dgongs pa'i zab gnad ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje phag mor gsal ba'i bha ga padma 'dab bzhir gyur pa'i dbus su bam̐ dang 'dab ma bzhir ha ri ni sa gsal gdab/ yab rta mgrin du gsal ba'i gsang rtags rdo rje rtse lnga pa hrīḥyig gis mtshan pa can du gsal gdab cing khro bo rdo rje zhi ba padma la snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe ye shes kyi rlung dar gcig bzung nas snang srid thams cad ye shes gcig gi ngang du 'ub chub par bsam/ slar yang yab yum gnyis kyi dga' bde'i rlung gis bskul nas lte ba'i a shad las me 'bar zhing dbu ma'i lam brgyud spyi bo'i haṃ yig la phog de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rnams la rang rang mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ thugs dam dang thugs rje byin rlabs ye shes yon tan thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par byung nas spyi bo nas thim/ rim bzhin 'khor lo lnga po gsang gnas kyi bar gang zhing khyab/ yang yum gyi padmor sim pa 86)dang sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas gsang rdzas dkar dmar gyi rnam par spyi bor byon pa na/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros gong bzhin bde gshegs rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i thugs rje ye shes byin rlabs sogs sngar bzhin spyi bor thim par bsam/ yang yum gyi gnas lnga nas rim gyis 'od zer 'phro 'du byas shing gsang sgor thon/ yab yum snyoms 'jug mdzad pa'i tshe las mthun gyi 'od zer phyir thon/ sems can thams cad kyi las sgrib sbyangs/ bsod nams gzi brjid dpal dang mnga' thang thams cad 'od zer gyi tshul du gsang sgor thim pas bde chen mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes la dbang thob cing gzi byin mchog tu 'bar bar bsam/ yang yab yum bsrubs sbyor mdzad pas 'khor 'das snang srid thams cad chos nyid gcig gi rol rtsal du ye grol chos sku'i klong du 'ub chub nas dga' bzhi dang stong bzhi'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur te/

rig stong bsam brjod dang bral ba ka dag zang thal skye 'gag gnas bral gyi dgongs par la bzlas nas rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas dag bi ma la lta bur gzhon nu bum skur grol nas kun bzang chos sku'i klong du gnyis med du 87)sangs rgyas pa'i gdams pa khyad par can no/ brgyud 'dzin gyi don du yin na dmigs rim gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra la/ gsang gnas kyi yig 'bru rnams ni rigs lnga yab yum gyi sa bon du gsal gdab pa dang*/ khyad par gyi dmigs pa ni yab yum gnyis sbyor gyi mtshams nas las mthun gyi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ bde gshegs rgyal kun phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid sprul pa'i sku de thugs thig le kha dog lnga ldan sran 'bru tsam zhig lcags kyu'i sne la drangs nas yum gyi padma la thim par mos/ yab yum gyi rgyu rkyen nyi zla'i gwa'u'i dbus su gnyis med du ma ro gcig tu brtan par bsam pa dang*/ yab yum bsrubs sbyor mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer rdo rje rin chen padma rgya gram 'khor lo sogs 'phros nas steng 'og thams cad srung ba'i gur khang chen por gyur par bsam/ lha dang mkha' 'gro bden tshig grub pa rnams kyis byin rlabs mdzad par bsam/ yab yum gyi rtsa khams rlung thig ba spu'i khung thams cad nas dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams bde stong gi ros tshim nas skus gar 88)bsgyur te bkra shis pa'i brda don rtags gsum yongs su rdzogs par byas nas 'gyur med sku dang*/ 'gag med gsung*/ 'khrul bral thugs/ yon tan phrin las kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin par bsam pa yin/ nged cag gi gnas tshul de ltar du lags pas khyod snod dang ldan na bdag gi padma la spyod cig ces smras nas bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ kho rang lhag pa'i dad pa skyes nas phyag dang bcas te 'di skad zer/ e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// gsang sngags lam zhugs rnal 'byor ma// bla med don ldan mkha' spyod ma// rnal 'byor dbang mo khyod nyid dang*// mi 'bral don gnyis dpal spyod nas// mkha' 'gro'i gling du 'khrid du gsol/

zhes zer nas a haṃ gi sgra bcas 'od thig dkar por gyur nas mi snang bar yal/ ces nyams snang la mi dkar rta dkar can gyi rgan po gzugs byad mi sdug pa lag na sba lcag dang zhags pa 'dzin pa tha mas gyi rnam pa can zhig gis khyed yab yum gnyis kyis sbyor sgrol gyi dmigs gnas ci lta ba bzhin yin tshul sba gsang med par gsung bar zhu/ bdag 89)kyang rjes su 'dzin pa'i bkrin mi chung bar zhu/ zhes zer ba'i lan du su kha badzra gyis bris pa'o// dge'o// las dang po pa rnams kyi las rgya'i dmigs rim ni/ yab rdor sems skyil krung mdzad pa'i pang du yum snyems ma dkar mor gsal ba'i zhabs gnyis yab kyi sku la 'khril sbyor gyi tshul du yab kyi rdo rje'i bu ga yum gyi gsang rtsa gandhe dang cung zad sbyar nas steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar te chos nyid kyi klong du dar gcig mnyam par bzhag de nas rlung dal bus gyen la drangs nas lte ba'i a shad las me mched/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud de spyi bo'i haṃ yig la phog haṃ las bdud rtsi dngul chu'i mdog lta bu spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar rlung gi rta la bskyon nas rdo rje'i bu ga bar mar babs pa la sems bzung zhing*/ rlung dar gcig bzung nas bde stong ye shes kyi ngo bo rig stong brjod bral gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi las sgrib bag chags thams cad dag nas zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bsam/ yang 'og rlung 90)gyen la drangs/ shes pa spyi bo'i haṃ yig la gtad tshe thig le phyir ldog nas gsang gnas nas spyi bo'i bar rim gyis gang*/ gnas lnga dang rtsa khams kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi thugs kyi dgyes pa bskangs nas/ rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa dang 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs nas sa bcu lam lnga'i ye shes lnga'i ye shes yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas te rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'bad med du 'grub par bsam la steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar nas dar gcig bzung ste chags bral ye shes kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag go

de ltar rlung sems la dbang ma thob bar du 'bad pa drag pos brtson par bya ba ni gnad dam pa'o/ rtsa rlung thig ler rang dbang thob ste mthar phyin pa na las rgya dngos kyi bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor la nyams su len pa'i tshe rdo rje chu 'thung gi gdams pa'i man ngag ni sbyor sgrol gsang lam ltar shes par bya'o/ zhes pa'ang gsang grogs bi ma la'i bzhed skong du bde ba'i rdo rjes snyan brgyud skor las gtan la phab pa dge/ sbyor sgrol gyi gnad 'gag : khro bo 91)rdo rje zhi ba padma dang 'phrad rjes rdo rje zhi ba la mi gnas pa ci'i phyir lags zhus pa'i lan du/ a haṃḥ las kyi phyag rgya mthar phyin nas: lus kyi phyag rgya mngon du gyur: gnyis med yid kyi phyag rgya yis: 'bral med bde chen ye shes bskyed: rdo rje khros pas nyon mongs bcom: rang bzhin bde chen rlabs g.yos pas: snang sems thug phrad ye shes 'char: ma bslabs shes rab rtogs pa rgyas: mkha' 'gro sems kyi 'phrul du shar: zab bcud man ngag dgongs pa khrol: snod ldan bu la gcig brgyud spel: theg dman blo chung skal med la: rlung phyogs ma spel a rgya sdoms: mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig rgya: snyan brgyud las gsang grogs las 'brel rtsal gyi bzhed skong du su kha badzra gyis bris pa'o// 92)
